entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-02-18
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • MapStaticAssets doesn't add correct Cache-Control headers #65463
  • Missing APIs in M.A.Server.HttpSys.xml and M.A.Server.IIS.xml in source-build #65461
  • Support Event Modifiers (stopPropagation, preventDefault) for Component Event Parameters #65459

Closed

  • HttpSysListener throws HEFException when WebApplication disposed (net10.0) #65259
    11.0-preview2
  • Kestrel Metrics can crash local test run #57579
    11.0-preview2
  • Validations in minimal APIs fails on several types from System.Text.Json #65424

PullRequests

Created

  • Atomically send GOAWAY during HTTP/2 abort #65465
    area-networking
  • Add support for localization to Microsoft.Extensions.Validation #65460
    area-blazor, * NO MERGE *, area-minimal, feature-validation
  • [release/10.0] Skip indexer properties in validation source generator #65458
    needs-area-label
  • Handle ObjectDisposedException in SignalR OnDisconnectedAsync during shutdown #65457
    area-signalr
  • Fix flaky Http2 test by using consistent ConnectionEndReason for closed streams #65456
    area-networking

Merged

  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #65455
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:, build-ops, 11.0-preview2
  • Port CI analysis Copilot skill and default it to aspnetcore #65464
    area-infrastructure, 11.0-preview2
  • [release/10.0] Add test helper and test cases to validate EventSource IDs #65427
    area-infrastructure, tell-mode, 10.0.4
  • Avoid disposing invalid handle in HttpSys server close #65378
    Servicing-approved, area-networking, 10.0.4
  • Fix Http3 connection close metric sometimes remaining Unset #65398
    feature-kestrel, area-networking, 11.0-preview2
  • Skip indexer properties in validation source generator #65432
    area-minimal, feature-validation, 11.0-preview2
  • Fix race in RST_STREAM_IncompleteRequest HTTP/2 tests #65454
    area-networking, 11.0-preview2

Updated

  • Fix RDG generating invalid code for types from other source generators #65453
    area-networking
  • feat: adds support for OpenAPI 3.2.0 #65415
    community-contribution, feature-openapi, area-minimal
  • Virtualization supports variable-height items #64964
    area-blazor
  • QuickGrid SSR support #65451
    area-blazor
  • fix: Allow pnpm execution without .cmd extension on Windows in SpaProxy #65386
    community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun, needs-area-label
